scope: MEAS: independent numerical, report/source, published note/bar-map, actual-sheet and visual review; not aural review.

defects.finding: The rendered page lacks the source-encoded first-strain repeat signs. The original spacer voice uses repeat volta count 1 around the eight full bars after the pickup; modern engraving suppresses its intended markers, while the performed score correctly repeats those bars.
defects.requiredFix: Use a guarded notation-only compatibility repair to restore the repeat beginning after pickup 0 at bar 1 and ending after bar 8. Preserve the original MIDI, musical notes, exact performed 0–8 / 1–24 order, 25 printed bar identities and 129-quarter grid. Re-publish, document the legacy repeat-visibility restoration and inspect both exact markers in the actual SVG; do not substitute an extra pickup or extra bars.

report.finding: Final gate values, 449 events / two piano staves, 33 performed bar occurrences and one-page 25-bar pack agree with checks/assets. The initially failing local region and two source-pitch fitting constraints are explicitly disclosed as non-independent. The report must also record the repeat-marker repair before acceptance.

barMap.finding: All 449 note bar/voice indices resolve, durations are positive and bar times strictly increase. Actual SVG/index identities are pickup 0 and 1–24. The complete page was inspected, including the bar-22 fermata and final cadence. Seconds-based formal labels can precede full-bar downbeats because their melodic pickups lie in the previous bar; no unresolved structured bar pointers occur.

overlays.finding: No gross pitch/order mismatch identified in the final constrained candidate. The late C5/A5 melodic rises now precede the bar-22 held harmony in the appropriate order. The two fitting anchors are not independent validation. The genuine final F2/A3/F4 attack remains near 193.146 s; its written two-quarter duration to the estimated 200.92 s decay end is not a measured key release.

version.finding: Complete piano No. 7, opening pickup then first eight full bars repeated, with the later return already written out. Timing/order are coherent, but the missing first-strain repeat notation prevents current sheet acceptance.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; the symbolic-source edition is not identified as Betts’s physical performing copy.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check performed by VerS. Passing constrained timing gates does not establish correct conversion of legacy engraving directives or physical note releases.
